subject: physics

hotspots.label: Cart
hotspots.description: The cart that receives the work as kinetic energy as it slides.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm amber cart on the track.
hotspots.function: Carries the kinetic energy the work becomes.

hotspots.label: Track with Marks
hotspots.description: The ruled straight track — distance is one of the two ingredients, and motion is mandatory for work.
hotspots.colorHint: Cool grey run with white tick marks.
hotspots.function: Provides the distance while the cart moves.

hotspots.label: Push Handle
hotspots.description: The force control — set the push strength that slides the cart.
hotspots.colorHint: An upright lever extending from the cart.
hotspots.function: Applies the force that multiplies into work.

hotspots.label: Work Counter
hotspots.description: Shows work in joules as force × distance builds it step by step.
hotspots.colorHint: A tall clean gauge at the track edge.

hotspots.label: Distance Marks
hotspots.description: The metre ruler ticks that multiply with force to give joules.
hotspots.colorHint: White ticks along the track rail.
hotspots.function: Marks the distance term of work.

hotspots.label: Cart Kinetic-Energy Badge
hotspots.description: The glow readout matching the work counter — same joules, now in motion form.
hotspots.colorHint: Soft green badge floating above the cart.
hotspots.function: Matches the work as kinetic energy.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette, a ruled cool-grey track, warm amber cart and handle, and a green work gauge.
materialNotes: Roughness ~0.5, metallic 0; a slim green badge with slight luminance only through texture, no bloom.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: work = force × distance on a cart track.

GEOMETRY: a straight ruled track with metre marks along +x; a cart with a push handle; a work counter; a kinetic-energy badge above the cart position.

INTERACTION: pressing the handle shoves the cart a set distance; every push adds force × distance to the counter and the badge rises by the same joules.

NAMED NODES: Track, Cart, PushHandle, WorkCounter, DistMarks, EnergyBadge. 7-9k tris.
